requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete nine lower division units, including at least one 200 division course.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The program requires 15 or 16 units in 300 and 400 division history courses, with at least four units in each division.

sections.note:
To enter the program, students must contact the departmental advisor ( histadv@sfu.ca ).
A history minor can be added at any time.
